title: Estimating Image Creativity
abstract: arXiv:2611.15044v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: What makes an image creative? Although this may seem like a highly subjective decision, research in psychology suggests that creativity may be based on a set of fundamental creativity dimensions such as novelty, surprise, and arousal. A deeper understanding of image creativity can benefit both research and practical applications. Exploring how human viewers use creativity dimensions to evaluate image creativity may allow us to predict a target image's human-rated creativity automatically. We present a novel framework to estimate the perceived creativity of an image by: (1) predicting the strengths of an image's novelty, surprise, and arousal creativity dimensions, and (2) combining the creativity dimension strengths to estimate an image creativity score. Controlled human-subject experiments were conducted on Amazon Mechanical Turk to collect data to train supervised machine learning models to estimate an image's strengths on the three

translated_abstract: 是什么让一张图像具有创造性？虽然这看起来像是一个高度主观的判断，但心理学研究表明，创造性可能基于一组基本的创造性维度，例如新颖性、惊喜度和唤醒度。对图像创造力的更深入理解可以使研究和实际应用都受益。探索人类观察者如何使用创造性维度来评估图像创造力，或许能让我们自动预测目标图像的人类评分创造力。我们提出了一个新颖的框架来估计图像的感知创造力，具体包括：（1）预测图像在新颖性、惊喜度和唤醒度这三个创造性维度上的强度；（2）将各创造性维度的强度结合起来，以估计图像的创造力分数。研究在Amazon Mechanical Turk上进行了受控的人类受试者实验，以收集数据来训练监督机器学习模型，从而估计图像在这三个维度上的强度。
tldr: 该论文提出了一个新颖的图像创造力估计框架，通过预测图像在新颖性、惊喜度和唤醒度三个创造性维度上的强度，并将其组合成创造力分数，实现自动预测人类对图像创造力的评分。
en_tdlr: The paper presents a novel framework for estimating image creativity by predicting the strengths of novelty, surprise, and arousal dimensions and combining them to predict human-rated creativity scores.
